vo: Say a seller's toys sit on hold.
Its certificate cites only the toy standard, part twelve-fifty.
Painted? Usually add thirteen-oh-three. Under three? Fifteen-oh-one too.
Say yours is painted, for toddlers. At least two are missing.
Not sure which rules apply? Free CPSC finder, no account needed.
caption:
Toys stuck on hold, and the certificate cites one rule?
A children's toy certificate (CPC) has to list every applicable rule separately, not just the toy standard.
16 CFR part 1250 makes the applicable parts of ASTM F963-23 mandatory for toys. A painted toy for kids usually also falls under the lead paint ban, 16 CFR 1303.
A toy for children under 3 also falls under the small parts rule, 16 CFR 1501.

sources.claim: Certificates must list every applicable rule separately
sources.quote: Finished product certificates must identify separately all applicable rules, bans, standards, or regulations.

sources.claim: Part 1250 is the toy standard; ASTM F963-23 mandatory
sources.quote: This part establishes a consumer product safety standard for toys. ... (a) Each toy must comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F963-23

sources.claim: Provisions restating existing bans are not part of 1250 (so 1303/1501 are cited on their own)
sources.quote: any provision of ASTM F963 that restates or incorporates an existing mandatory standard or ban promulgated by the Commission or by statute ... are not part of the mandatory standard incorporated in paragraph (a) of this section.

sources.claim: Lead paint ban covers children's toys bearing lead-containing paint
sources.quote: (1) Toys and other articles intended for use by children that bear “lead-containing paint”.

sources.claim: Small parts rule covers toys for children under 3
sources.quote: applies to all toys and other articles intended for use by children under 3 years (36 months) of age

sources.claim: Children's product = 12 or younger (so CPC, not GCC)
sources.quote: a children's product means a consumer product designed or intended primarily for children 12 years of age or younger.
